purpose: Evaluator-only cases. Give agents only task-local prompts and supplied artifacts, not expected behaviors or failure signals. Definitions are not execution evidence.

briefs.task: Build a welcoming first-entry interface for a family nature journal, with journal naming, a sample discovery, and a useful phone layout.
constraints: No separate request to generate an image
expected_behaviors: Assess imagery without waiting for permission to make routine design choices
Generate useful expressive art when available
Choose and measure alpha if the composition uses a cutout
Integrate and inspect real output in the UI
failure_signals: Only prompts or a mood board
Primitive SVG standing in for rich art
No rendered inspection despite available tools

briefs.task: Build a chosen immersive coastal journal cover with editable title and an action opening a sample chapter.
expected_behaviors: Produce an opaque environment when appropriate
Keep title and controls editable
Inspect mobile crop and contrast
Deliver actual assets with consumers
failure_signals: Transparent subject where the chosen scene requires a full environment

briefs.task: Polish search, navigation, sorting, action, and status iconography in the supplied approved equipment queue.
constraints: Preserve layout, copy, colors, type, and behavior
expected_behaviors: Choose or extend one coherent icon family
Verify source/exports and license
Check semantic meanings and actual-size weight
Preserve accessible controls
Avoid unrelated imagery
failure_signals: Invented SVG approximations despite a suitable family
Unrequested decorative assets or layout changes

briefs.task: Inspect these supplied assets for placement as foreground cutouts on light and dark surfaces.
supplied_facts: Actual files include an opaque checkerboard, fully opaque RGBA, an empty-alpha image, and a valid visible cutout
constraints: Show measured and visual evidence separately
expected_behaviors: Decode and measure alpha
Reject empty and wholly opaque assets for cutout use
View edges on actual and contrasting mattes
Do not infer beauty from numeric alpha

briefs.task: Review supplied stylized onboarding illustrations and identify which need production revisions.
supplied_facts: Images intentionally use flat color and exaggerated proportions
One has an observed boundary/continuity defect
constraints: Record findings at source coordinates and final display size
expected_behaviors: Distinguish stylization from accidental defects
Inspect whole/native/context views
Test alternative explanations
Recommend a localized repair and neighboring-region recheck

briefs.task: Complete the image-led layout using the capabilities and output representation actually exposed in this run.
supplied_facts: Use the live host tool schema
A variant may return preview-only output or explicitly lack generation
expected_behaviors: Discover native tools before declaring them absent
Use supported export/transfer
Continue available work
Name an actual blocker if output cannot be obtained
failure_signals: Demanding an API key for an available native tool
Reporting verified integration from a preview

briefs.task: Extend an approved onboarding illustration with two related steps while preserving the established character.
expected_behaviors: Carry palette, viewpoint, edges, detail density, and scale across the family
Inspect individual files and side-by-side placement
Repair outliers
Keep origin and quality separate
failure_signals: Claiming camera authenticity because the result looks good

briefs.task: Repair a correctly drawn foreground asset that overlaps the title and blocks a control at narrow widths.
constraints: Preserve the asset if it is not defective
expected_behaviors: Diagnose layout/anchor/layer ownership
Repair responsive placement and hit testing
Inspect affected viewports
Avoid unnecessary regeneration
failure_signals: Deleting meaningful imagery without trying recomposition
Lowering image opacity instead of repairing alpha

briefs.task: Review the supplied flat editorial illustrations for a gardening onboarding panel at 560px and 220px on cream. Floating droplets and irregular decorative marks are intentional.
supplied_facts: Only the two raster captures from illustration-structure-cases.html
constraints: Inspect actual images, not evaluator source geometry
expected_behaviors: Locate the detached spout in R
Recognize the connected construction in S
Do not reject deliberate flatness or floating droplets
Separate construction from export and untested placement
failure_signals: Praise both images without tracing joins
Invent faults in the coherent control

briefs.task: Review the supplied transparent artwork and its delivery derivative on the intended light and dark surfaces.
supplied_facts: Some viewer representations expose colors in zero-alpha pixels
constraints: Inspect actual alpha-aware composites before requesting repair
expected_behaviors: Distinguish invisible RGB from actual edge contamination
Check native exterior and interior boundaries
Do not regenerate to fix a display artifact
Keep visible structural ambiguities separate from confirmed breaks
failure_signals: Flag raw-preview surround as an opaque background without checking alpha
Accept segmentation solely from RGBA metadata

briefs.task: Create one transparent flat editorial illustration of an open field notebook, a magnifying glass and a botanical specimen for a save-discovery state. Use ink blue, ivory and restrained green; it must work at 560px and 220px over cream or pale blue.
constraints: Keep operational UI and copy separate
expected_behaviors: Record concise construction and delivery conditions before generation
Use concrete object relations and coherent medium
Inspect native joins plus both sizes and mattes
Keep unresolved defects visible and make targeted repairs only when justified
failure_signals: Only a prompt without an image
No acceptance evidence beyond a generator self-rating
Claim a universal success rate from one result
